_note: Each fault is a deliberate bug in src/server.ts or src/http.ts (MCP_FAULTS). caught_by pins the exact tests that must fail; scripts/fault-matrix.ts enforces it.

lenient_schema.what: input schemas accept anything, so bad arguments reach the handlers

protocol.test.ts: invalid input to search_incidents is rejected with an error: {}
